notes.title: Gamescom 2025: The Blood of Dawnwalker Preview – The Start of a New Saga?
notes.content:
In a world where we have hundreds of thousands of games at our fingertips, the genre you love can easily get stale. Somehow, even with the dire need for something fresh in games, if the latest game isn’t a sequel, prequel, remaster or remake, the hype isn’t anywhere near what it could be for fear of the unknown. For me, RPGs and action-RPGs are my genre of choice, and new versions just haven’t spoken to me…until now.

I was able to watch an hour-long preview of The Blood of Dawnwalker from the new studio, Rebel Wolves and Bandai Namco. I can confidently tell you that they are bringing a fresh take on the action-RPG, and I am both excited and nervous to jump in hands-on.

During our session, we were able to see what I believe is the game’s opening cutscene, and then we jumped into a quest line a bit further in the game, when you would be familiar with the unique gameplay cycle and your abilities. That opening cutscene had me on the edge of my seat. I want to save spoilers... Read more

notes.title: The Blood of Dawnwalker - Game Trailer
notes.content: [h2][b]The Blood of Dawnwalker[/b] is the [b]first chapter of Rebel Wolves’ brand new role-playing saga[/b] — a [b]single-player open-world dark fantasy action-RPG[/b] with a strong [b]focus on story and narrative[/b], developed on Unreal Engine 5.[/h2][p][/p][h3]14th-century Europe. Bloody conflicts sweep the lands, and the [b]Black Death comes for the survivors[/b]. [b]Vampires seize their opportunity to walk out of the shadows[/b] and claim what they've been denied for centuries: [b]freedom, and the power that comes with it[/b].[/h3][p][/p][h3]You play as [b]Coen, a young man turned into a Dawnwalker[/b], forever treading the line [i][b]between the world of day and the realm of night[/b][/i]. Fight for your humanity or [b]embrace the cursed powers to save your family[/b].[/h3][p][/p][previewyoutube="xo0VciwlBwQ;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h2]Whatever your choice, the question stands: [b]is your soul worth the lives of those you love[/b]?[/h2][p][/p][h1][b]☼ 2026 ☽[/b][/h1][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3751260/The_Blood_of_Dawnwalker/"][/dynamiclink][/p]
